courses.title: Computer Vision
courses.description: Explore how computers interpret images and video. Start with the foundations of visual data, then learn how image processing and filters prepare images for computer vision tasks.
learningOutcomes: Explain how computers represent and interpret images
Describe pixels, image properties, and common processing steps
Understand how filters and convolution help analyze visual data

lessons.title: Introduction to Computer Vision
lessons.description: Get to know computer vision, how it differs from human vision, and where it is used in everyday technology.

lessons.title: Image Processing Basics
lessons.description: Learn how digital images are stored and how basic image operations prepare them for further analysis.

lessons.title: Filters and Convolution
lessons.description: See how a small filter moves across an image to blur, sharpen, and reveal useful visual patterns.

quizzes.question: What is the main goal of computer vision?
options: To help computers understand information in images and videos
To store files in a database
quizzes.correctAnswer: To help computers understand information in images and videos

quizzes.question: What is a digital image made up of?
What does a convolution filter do?
options: Applies a small calculation across an image to change or detect patterns
Changes an image into a database table
quizzes.correctAnswer: Applies a small calculation across an image to change or detect patterns

courses.title: Database Management System
courses.description: Learn how relational databases organize information. Practice describing data with entity-relationship models, retrieving records with SQL, and combining related tables.
learningOutcomes: Write a basic SQL query to retrieve records
Understand how joins connect related tables

lessons.title: Entity-Relationship Models
lessons.description: Plan a database before building it by identifying entities, their attributes, and how they relate.

lessons.title: SQL Basics: SELECT
lessons.description: Use SELECT queries to retrieve specific information from a relational database.

lessons.title: Joining Tables
lessons.description: Combine related records from two tables and learn when a basic SQL join is useful.

quizzes.question: What does an entity represent in an ER model?
options: A type of thing or concept about which the database stores information
A command that deletes a table
A color used to draw diagrams
quizzes.correctAnswer: A type of thing or concept about which the database stores information

quizzes.question: Which SQL command is used to retrieve data?
Why would you use a SQL JOIN?
options: To combine related rows from multiple tables
To rename every column in a database
To remove duplicate files from a computer
quizzes.correctAnswer: To combine related rows from multiple tables

courses.title: Natural Language Processing
courses.description: Discover how software works with human language. Learn foundational text preparation techniques and see how a model can identify the sentiment expressed in text.
learningOutcomes: Explain why text needs to be prepared before analysis
Describe tokenization and common preprocessing steps
Recognize a basic sentiment analysis task

lessons.title: Text Preprocessing and Tokenization
lessons.description: Explore how raw text can be cleaned and split into tokens that a program can process.

lessons.title: Introduction to Sentiment Analysis
lessons.description: Learn how text classification can identify whether a sentence expresses a positive, negative, or neutral opinion.

quizzes.question: What is tokenization?
options: Breaking text into smaller units such as words or subwords
quizzes.correctAnswer: Breaking text into smaller units such as words or subwords

quizzes.question: What does sentiment analysis try to identify?
options: The opinion or emotional tone expressed in text
The number of images on a website
The size of a database table
The speed of a network connection
quizzes.correctAnswer: The opinion or emotional tone expressed in text

courses.title: Object-Oriented Programming
courses.description: Build a foundation in object-oriented programming. Work with classes and objects, then learn how inheritance, polymorphism, and encapsulation help organize code.
learningOutcomes: Distinguish a class from an object
Explain inheritance and polymorphism with examples
Describe how encapsulation organizes and protects data

lessons.title: Classes and Objects
lessons.description: Understand a class as a blueprint and create objects that hold data and provide behavior.

lessons.title: Inheritance and Polymorphism
lessons.description: See how classes can share behavior through inheritance and respond to the same operation in different ways.

lessons.title: Encapsulation
lessons.description: Learn how an object can keep its data and the operations that use that data together.

quizzes.question: In object-oriented programming, what is a class?
options: A blueprint used to create objects
quizzes.correctAnswer: A blueprint used to create objects

quizzes.question: What does inheritance allow a class to do?
options: Reuse or extend behavior from another class
Turn source code into an image
Store a video in a browser
Remove all methods from an object
quizzes.correctAnswer: Reuse or extend behavior from another class

quizzes.question: What is a common purpose of encapsulation?
options: Keep data and related behavior together and control access
Connect a website to a video service
Convert a class into a database
quizzes.correctAnswer: Keep data and related behavior together and control access

courses.title: Web Technology Workshop
courses.description: Follow the building blocks of a web application: structure pages with HTML, style them with CSS, add behavior with JavaScript, and create an API using ExpressJS.
learningOutcomes: Create and style a basic web page
Understand the role of an ExpressJS API

lessons.title: Structure and Styling with HTML and CSS
lessons.description: Build the semantic structure of a webpage and apply CSS to control its layout and appearance.

lessons.title: Interactivity with JavaScript
lessons.description: Learn the basics of JavaScript and how it can make a webpage respond to user actions.

lessons.title: Backend APIs with ExpressJS
lessons.description: See how ExpressJS can define server routes and respond to requests from a web application.

lessons.title: Responsive Layouts with Media Queries
lessons.description: Use CSS media queries to adjust a page layout for different screen sizes.

quizzes.question: Which HTML tag is used to link an external CSS file?
Which JavaScript method is commonly used to respond to a browser event?
What is ExpressJS commonly used for?
options: Building web applications and APIs with Node.js
quizzes.correctAnswer: Building web applications and APIs with Node.js

quizzes.question: What is a CSS media query used for?
options: Applying styles when conditions such as screen width match
quizzes.correctAnswer: Applying styles when conditions such as screen width match

courses.title: Business classes
courses.description: Get started with React by building interfaces from components. Learn how props pass information, how state tracks changes, and how effects and routes connect a small application.
learningOutcomes: Describe how React components form a user interface
Pass information with props and update values with state
Use effects and routes in a small React application

lessons.title: Components and Props
lessons.description: Break a user interface into reusable components and pass each component the information it needs.

lessons.title: Managing State with useState
lessons.description: Use the useState hook to remember values and update the interface in response to user actions.

lessons.title: Working with useEffect
lessons.description: Learn how useEffect can synchronize a component with external systems and load data.

lessons.title: Page Navigation with React Router
lessons.description: Add client-side navigation so people can move between pages in a React application.

quizzes.question: What is a React component?
options: A reusable part of a user interface
quizzes.correctAnswer: A reusable part of a user interface

quizzes.question: What does the useState hook provide?
options: A way for a component to keep and update state
A way to define an HTML document
quizzes.correctAnswer: A way for a component to keep and update state

quizzes.question: When is useEffect commonly used?
options: To synchronize a component with an external system
To create a new HTML tag
quizzes.correctAnswer: To synchronize a component with an external system

quizzes.question: What does client-side routing help with in a React app?
options: Moving between views without loading a new HTML page each time
Playing a video without a URL
quizzes.correctAnswer: Moving between views without loading a new HTML page each time
